hero.headline: Nisha, Raj, Aanya and Kiran
hero.blurb: A whole household invited, which felt like the only sensible option given how much of our own lives you have been in.

menu.intro: Adults pick from the full menu. Aanya and Kiran have their own, designed after careful consultation with a nine-year-old.

options.label: Ice cream, three scoops (children)
options.description: Kiran has been promised this. Do not let us renege.

sections.title: The children's situation
sections.body: There is a quiet room off the main barn with beanbags, a projector and someone we are paying specifically to supervise it from 7pm. Bring pyjamas; several children will end the night asleep in a heap.

facts.label: Room
facts.value: Family room held at The Wickham Arms

faq.q: Is there somewhere to warm things up?
faq.a: Yes — the barn kitchen is happy to help, just find Maria on the day.

privateNotes: Nisha is a bridesmaid — she'll need to arrive at 10am on the day. Raj is handling the kids until the ceremony.
